<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="ur_bdi6QnuRAL4A5sN1Z" name="Page-5"> <mxGraphModel dx="1494" dy="1255" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false

actor \"Subject Teacher\" as ST
actor \"Class Teacher\" as CT
actor \"School Head / Principal\" as SH
actor \"Parent / Learner\" as PL
actor \"System Admin\" as SA

rectangle \"CBC Analytics & Decision Support System\" {
 ' Subject Teacher Use Cases
 usecase \"Record Substrand Rubrics\" as UC_Rubrics
 usecase \"Enter Qualitative Observations\" as UC_Remarks
 usecase \"View Subject-Level Trends\" as UC_SubjTrends

 ' Class Teacher Use Cases
 usecase \"Generate Term Competency Aggregate\" as UC_Aggregate
 usecase \"Trigger Pathway Prediction\" as UC_Predict
 usecase \"Review / Override AI Recommendation\n(Ethical Safeguard)\" as UC_Override
 usecase \"Calculate Feature Vectors\" as UC_Features
 usecase \"Generate SHAP Attribution Breakdown\" as UC_SHAP

 ' School Head Use Cases
 usecase \"View Cohort-Level At-Risk Heatmap\" as UC_Heatmap
 usecase \"Audit Institutional Placement Analytics\" as UC_Placement
 usecase \"Export Ministry / KNEC Summary\" as UC_Export

 ' Parent / Learner Use Cases
 usecase \"View Core Competency Radar\" as UC_Radar
 usecase \"Inspect Career Pathway Options & Explanations\" as UC_Inspect

 ' Admin Use Cases
 usecase \"Manage Users & Role Permissions\" as UC_Admin
}

' Connections - Subject Teacher
ST --> UC_Rubrics
ST --> UC_Remarks
ST --> UC_SubjTrends

' Connections - Class Teacher
CT --> UC_Aggregate
CT --> UC_Predict
CT --> UC_Override

' Include and Extend relationships
UC_Predict ..> UC_Features : <<include>>
UC_Predict ..< UC_SHAP : <<extend>>
UC_Aggregate ..> UC_Predict : <<include>>

' Connections - School Head
SH --> UC_Heatmap
SH --> UC_Placement
SH --> UC_Export

' Connections - Parent / Learner
PL --> UC_Radar
PL --> UC_Inspect

' Connections - Admin
SA --> UC_Admin
@enduml",
 "config": null
